agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario has one body with very high horizontal speed (vx~38.9, dt~0.0157, displacement ~0.61 per step) and no walls. Substepping (21 substeps) is insufficient to enforce arena clipping. At step 21 body is just inside arena (x=18.95, overshoot -0.22) and at step 22 it has moved to x=19.57 with radius 0.823, overshoot +0.389 >0.15, triggering in_arena. Reducing initial speed to 15 (one-field change) keeps body inside bounds for same 22 steps, confirming high velocity / insufficient boundary enforcement is causal.
